description: Version-controlled repository ownership policy for G14 git cleanliness gate. Declares which paths are persistent user workspace, generated output, or qualification-owned. Files not matching any category remain UNKNOWN and release-blocking.
protectedPathNote: Any modification (tracked or untracked) to files under protectedPaths ALWAYS causes G14 FAIL, regardless of ownership classification. This is non-negotiable.
userWorkspaceNote: These paths are declared as persistent user workspace. Untracked or modified files matching these patterns are classified as USER_OWNED and do not cause G14 failure. However, if a file under a protectedPath also matches a userWorkspacePath, protectedPath takes precedence (FAIL).
generatedOutputNote: These are generated by the qualification process. They are expected outputs and do not cause G14 failure. Canonical evidence is committed; transient copies may appear during gate runs.
transientNote: Temporary files that are safe to ignore. These should also be in .gitignore.
unknownPolicy: Any file that does not match protectedPaths, userWorkspacePaths, generatedOutputPatterns, or transientPatterns is classified as UNKNOWN and MUST cause G14 FAIL. This ensures new unexpected modifications are always caught.
precedenceRules: 1. protectedPaths takes absolute precedence — any match means FAIL
2. If not protected, check userWorkspacePaths — match means USER_OWNED (allowed)
3. If not user workspace, check generatedOutputPatterns — match means GENERATED (allowed)
4. If not generated, check transientPatterns — match means TRANSIENT (allowed)
